name: encrypted-first-boot
title: Unlock and first boot of an encrypted installation
description: The disk was produced by install_encrypted.sh (LUKS2 under root, bootc install to-filesystem) and rides in as a derived disk with its installation record. The passphrase prompt must appear on the console, the correct passphrase must unlock and boot, and no credential may appear anywhere in the evidence — the runner sends but never logs it, and the forbidden marker hunts for the test passphrase file's marker string in case anything ever echoes it.
$timeoutNote: LUKS2 defaults to argon2id with parameters cryptsetup benchmarks on the machine that formats the volume. The build host is fast and many-cored; the scenario VM is neither, so unlock alone took minutes and the whole boot ran past a 1200s deadline while succeeding. Measured, not guessed: the run reached multi-user.target and finished the health check at ~1211s.
